description: Build-time schema for extension.json files used by GitHub Copilot extensions.

name.description: Action name exposed by the canvas provider

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the action input

CanvasAction.description: Canvas action that the agent or host can invoke. To discover the input schema for a particular action, call the list_canvas_capabilities tool.
CanvasAction.title: CanvasAction

CanvasJsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for canvas open input
CanvasJsonSchema.title: CanvasJsonSchema

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema location used by authoring tools. The runtime ignores this value.

ExtensionManifest.description: Declarative contributions used to advertise an extension before its process starts.

ProtocolExternalToolDefer.description: Controls whether the runtime may defer loading an external tool definition.
ProtocolExternalToolDefer.title: ProtocolExternalToolDefer

x-enumDescriptions.auto: The runtime may defer the tool according to its tool-loading policy.
x-enumDescriptions.never: The runtime must include the tool without deferring it.

description.description: Model-visible explanation of what the tool does.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input arguments.

overridesBuiltInTool.description: Whether this definition replaces a built-in tool with the same name.

skipPermission.description: Whether execution bypasses the normal tool permission prompt.

hasHandler.description:
Whether the SDK has a local handler for this tool. Set by the SDK, not the model.
On explicit continuation, an unanswered handler-backed call is interrupted
when the resuming SDK also registers a handler; it is never replayed.

isTerminal.description: Whether the tool executes commands in a terminal.

idempotent.description:
Whether repeating a call with the same arguments has no additional effect
beyond the first call, as is true of any tool without side effects. Hosts
may use this to safely repeat a call whose outcome was lost. It does not
affect permission checks.

metadata.description: Optional caller-defined metadata associated with the tool.

namespace.description:
Optional namespace grouping this tool with related tools. Where the model
provider supports native tool namespaces, deferred tools sharing a namespace
are presented to the model as one group; elsewhere the tool stays flat. The
tool's `name` remains its unique invocation name either way.

ProtocolExternalToolDefinition.description: Serializable definition of a caller-implemented tool whose execution is handled over the SDK connection.
ProtocolExternalToolDefinition.title: ProtocolExternalToolDefinition

name.description: Namespace name: 1-64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

description.description: Optional model-visible explanation of the tools in this namespace.

ProtocolExternalToolNamespace.description: Namespace that groups related caller-implemented tools for model tool discovery.
ProtocolExternalToolNamespace.title: ProtocolExternalToolNamespace
